edition_rule: Same rule as vampire-blood-magic: a ladder-rank level noted 'dark ages' or '2nd ed.' leaves the base family before the ladder fills and goes to darkages-vampire_disciplines.json or 2nded-vampire_disciplines.json. Above-ladder picks carrying the same note stay where they are (they are valid picks, not overflow) and keep the tag in `pick_editions`.

Necromancy.superseded_by: vampire-blood-magic (Sepulchre Path, Bone Path, Ash Path)
Necromancy.evidence: Owner ruling 2026-09-22, closing Q5: drop it. Every ladder level of this family was noted '2nd ed.' (Summon Spirit, Insight, Compel Spirit, Soul Stealing, source menu 'Necromancy, Vampire'), and the lookup the same day found no book that prints it as a five-rung ladder: The Masquerade Second Edition (WW05200) has no Necromancy at all, and the 2nd-edition compilation that does carry these names - Laws of the Night, 'information from Masquerade 2nd Edition, The Masquerade Players' Guide and Antagonists' - gives Necromancy one power per tier (Summon Spirit basic, Compel Spirit intermediate, Soul Stealing advanced). Grapevine's fourth entry, Insight, is the Sepulchre Path's own first power, from a different book. So the family is a Grapevine compilation of a superseded printing, and filling its fifth rung would have meant inventing a power. vampire-blood-magic already carries the three real MET Necromancy paths. Production holds none of it: read-only counts on both live sites found 12 Necromancy-named holdings on kony and 8 on Boston, every one a ritual or a blood-magic path, and zero in vampire-disciplines - so the drop strands nobody. **No alias and no moved_from, deliberately:** a held 'Necromancy N' in this block has no single target - the compilation's three names span two different real paths and the blood-magic families print their own (Insight, Summon Soul, Compel Soul, Haunting, Torment) - so any mapping would be invented rather than recorded, and there is no holding anywhere for it to route.

Awakening of the Steel.evidence: B-5. Identical ladder to vampire-blood-magic's Awakening the Steel (a Dur-An-Ki path). Grapevine nests it under the Assamite menu, which is how it reached the Discipline block.

Obtenebration.evidence: Overflow 'Tenebrous Form' (note 'Advanced', the CSV's capitalisation) is the advanced rung under its other printed name: same rank, same cost, one per source (GVM 'Shadow Body', MET CSV 'Tenebrous Form'). Kept as an alias of the rung, not a second advanced power. The dark ages overflow moves by the edition rule.

Vicissitude.evidence: Overflow 'Blood Form' (note 'Advanced') is rung 5 spelled as two words.

Bardo.evidence: Two advanced powers for one advanced rung (Mummification Ritual, Ra's Blessing). V20 (tt/v20-bloodline-disciplines.json) prints Mummification at eight dots - above the ladder - so Mummification Ritual becomes an elder pick and Ra's Blessing takes rung 5. Reprices Mummification Ritual 9 -> 12, forward only. See Owner questions: the other two sources disagree on names past rung 2.

Daimoinon.evidence: Overflow 'Sens the Sin' / 'Fear the Void Below' are rungs 1-2 under a typo and an alternate wording (Faith and Fire prints 'Sense the Sin', 'Fear of the Void'). The dark ages overflow (Essence of the Netherworld, Curse) moves by the edition rule and matches Faith and Fire's Dark Ages ladder.

Deimos.evidence: Short ladder: 2/1/1. The Long Night prints only four Deimos powers; its note says Faith and Fire's version of the same discipline (Path of the Four Humours) shares Whispers to the Soul, Kiss of the Dark Mother and Black Breath. Faith and Fire's second intermediate, Dark Humours, fills the rung. Clutching the Shroud stays an elder pick as Grapevine prices it.

Flight.options_note: Combat maneuvers usable once the corresponding Flight level is known - not separately purchased (Faith and Fire; the book names Pounce, Plunge and Dive, Grapevine names the second Slam).
Flight.evidence: Overflow was the five rungs again as 'Level One'..'Level Five' (placeholder duplicates), plus Pounce/Slam/Dive at an unclassified cost of 2. Faith and Fire (met/faith-and-fire-gargoyle-powers.json) says the maneuvers are not bought; they become the family's options.

Gargoyle Powers.evidence: Faith and Fire: 'non-progressive body modification powers purchased individually (not leveled)', XP 3/6/9 by power (met/faith-and-fire-gargoyle-powers.json). Eight 'unknown'-tier items can never fill a ladder. Moved to a sibling trait_list per 1.2.10 A4. See Owner questions.

Ritual.evidence: Source menu 'Rituals, Gargoyle' - the same nine rituals already seeded in vampire-rituals as 'Gargoyle: <name> (<tier>)', priced 2/4/6 as rituals. A ritual list reached the Discipline block through the Gargoyle Powers submenu.

Long Night Combo.evidence: Source menu 'Disciplines, Long Night Combo' is vampire-combo-disciplines' own source menu (gvm-block-map.php). Eleven combination powers, not a ladder.

fill.name: Death's Whisper
fill.filled_from: Vampire: The Dark Ages (WW02800) p. 152-154 - Mortis runs Masque of Death (1), Blight (2), Awaken (3), Death's Whisper (4), Black Death (5), with Vigor Mortis at six

Mortis.evidence: Short ladder: 2/1/1 (Masque of Death, Blight, Awaken, Black Death). **Looked up 2026-09-22 on the owner's ruling.** Mind's Eye Theatre: Faith and Fire (WW05038) does not print this ladder at all - its Mortis is three separate paths (Grave's Decay, Corpse in the Monster, Cadaverous Animation, plus the Lamia's Four Humours), every one of which vampire-blood-magic already carries under the Mortis tradition. The ladder Grapevine seeded is the tabletop one, Vampire: The Dark Ages (WW02800) p. 152-154, where every other name in this family matches exactly and the fourth dot is Death's Whisper. That fills the rung from the family's own source; the placeholder is gone. Recorded for a later boundary ruling, not acted on here: this family covers concepts blood magic already carries as three paths.

Spiritus.evidence: Short ladder: 2/1/1 with Engling Fury as an elder pick. The Sabbat Storyteller's Handbook (tt/storytellers-handbook-sabbat-bloodline-disciplines.json) numbers Spiritus 1 Speak with Spirits, 2 Summon Spirit Beasts, 3 Aspect of the Beast, 4 Engling Fury, 5 The Wildebeest - so Engling Fury is rung 4. Reprices it 12 -> 6, forward only.

Valeren.evidence: T-T5. Overflow was rungs 1-2 printed again - 'Sense Vitaility' (typo) and 'Anesthetic Touch' (the correct spelling of rung 2, which was the typo 'Anethetic'; the Sabbat Guide prints 'Anesthetic Touch'). Healer and Warrior stay their own families.

variant_retier_evidence.dark-ages:Protean: Grapevine's Dark Ages Protean prints three basics (Witness of Darkness, Talons of the Beast, Interred in Earth), one intermediate and one advanced - five powers in book order on a 2/1/1-plus-one shape. The third power is the third rung, and the ladder is the rule, so Interred in Earth is the first intermediate; its modern counterpart, Earth Meld, is intermediate too. Reprices it 3 -> 6 in the variant only.
